intro: The Ontar isn’t just a table—it’s your partner in creating a calm, inviting living room. Its marble-inspired top and roomy storage make staying organised feel effortless and stylish.

features.title: Glossy finish for everyday elegance
features.text: Bring the elegance of Afyon Marble into your home with a glossy top that exudes sophistication and timeless charm.

features.title: Roomy shelves for clutter-free living
features.text: Showcase your style! Ample shelving keeps books, décor, and essentials neatly organised yet beautifully displayed.

features.title: Square shape fits anywhere with ease
features.text: Our Ontar table fits like a dream. Whether in cosy corners or spacious rooms, it elevates your layout beautifully.

features.title: Strong build that lasts for years
features.text: Spills and splashes are no problem thanks to our moisture-resistant boards, which maintain their look and strength through everyday mishaps.

features.title: Layout-friendly for any room arrangement
features.text: Furnishing a cosy nook or a spacious living room? Our adaptable table fits effortlessly into any layout, making it easy to refresh your space whenever you like.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
